title: Lava Framework
summary: The Lava framework is an open-source software tool developed by the Intel Neuromorphic Computing Team for neuromorphic computing. It provides abstractions to map neuro-inspired applications onto hardware and supports various neuron models, network topologies, and training tools. The library features a modular structure allowing integration of algorithms and interfaces with third-party devices while remaining platform-agnostic across different operating systems and architectures. Lava enables prototyping on standard CPUs/GPUs before deployment on neuromorphic chips, emphasizing hyper-granular parallelism, dynamic neural networks, forward connectivity between models, and high energy efficiency.
tldr: Lava is an Intel-developed open-source framework for developing neuro-inspired applications compatible with various hardware architectures.
evidence: Lava is an open-source software framework designed for neuromorphic computing
Developed and maintained by the Intel Neuromorphic Computing Team
The library offers a modular structure for integrating algorithms and supports a wide variety of neuron models, network topologies, and training tools
